content.comment_body: Is there a way to extend a shift register to 12 bits for use on a [product_name]? I want to display the 12 months of the year one after another, ideally using just one function key on a [product_name] operator device. I managed to make it work up to August, but I can't figure out how to get an additional shift register to display the remaining months in sequence.
Are you aware that there are multiple shift registers available? There are actually four. Perhaps you could connect two shift registers in sequence?
Thank you, this solves my problem perfectly.

analysis.insight_summary: Users explored how to expand a shift register function on a [product_name] hardware module to display all 12 months in order. The initial solution managed only up to 8 steps, but advice was given to use multiple shift registers in series. A proposed solution was provided and accepted, demonstrating adaptability in feature usage and effective community support for troubleshooting.
analysis.user_expectations: User wants to extend shift register functionality to display all 12 months in sequence with minimal complexity, preferably utilizing a single function key in an integrated and straightforward way.
